description: This file implements an EtcdStore class for distributed coordination in PyTorch, interfacing with etcd for key-value storage, including methods for setting, getting, adding, waiting, and checking keys, with base64 encoding for binary data.

classes.name: EtcdStore
classes.description: A class implementing a distributed store interface using etcd, extending torch.distributed.Store, with methods for key-value operations and synchronization.

methods.name: cas_delay
methods.description: Introduces a small random delay to reduce CAS failures in etcd operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EtcdStore with etcd client, prefix, and optional timeout.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in etcd, encoding data in base64.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from etcd, with optional blocking wait until key is available.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Atomically increments a numeric value associated with a key in etcd.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until all specified keys are published or timeout occurs.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if all specified keys are immediately present in etcd.

methods.name: _encode
methods.description: Encodes a string or bytes into base64 string.

methods.name: _decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into bytes.

methods.name: _try_wait_get
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve multiple keys from etcd, waiting for their publication or timing out.
